summary: Median strip between Moggill Road carriageways at a junction; nowhere to stop.
reasons: Median island, live lanes both sides

drivers.seclusion: Open junction; homes 22-39 m north across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Line is on a raised median; a van would block a lane.
drivers.convention: No parked cars; clearway tow-away sign.

sun_shade: Mostly open; one tree shades the west end.
